posts.text: constrained decoding fixes most structured-output pain. give the model a grammar, stop asking it to remember the schema.
shipped the inference server rewrite. p50 dropped from 90ms to 38ms. mostly batching and killing a dumb lock.
local models are good enough now that i run the whole dev loop offline. no api bill, no rate limit, no telemetry.
sqlite wal + fts5 is my default stack for anything single-node. reach for postgres when you actually shard, not before.
spent two days on a bug that was a missing index. the profiler would have found it in ten minutes. lesson relearned.
the hard part of tooling is not the feature, it is the twenty edge cases that make it trustworthy overnight.
quantization is a lever, not a free lunch. 4-bit is fine for chat, rough for code, measure before you ship it.
wrote a tiny scheduler with jitter instead of cron. regular intervals are a smell in anything that talks to a rate limiter.
reading the replies before you reply is underrated. half my drafts die there because someone already said it better.
most agent frameworks are a for-loop and a prompt wearing a trench coat. write the loop yourself, you will understand it.
backpressure is the whole game in a pipeline. if one stage cannot say no, the crash just moves downstream.
idempotency keys turned a class of 3am pages into a non-event. write the intent before you do the thing.
